task: I'm a solo founder. I have three things on my plate this week: (a) close two warm B2B leads who asked for a proposal, (b) ship a payments bug that's blocking 3 customers from upgrading, (c) write the first draft of our SEO landing page strategy. I have ~25 working hours. What should I do, in what order, and what should I explicitly NOT do?
rationale: Hard-to-undo prioritization decision; good test of single-call cofounder vs propose-then-critique.

task: Audit this Laravel 12 checkout flow for production readiness. Files: app/Http/Controllers/CheckoutController.php, app/Jobs/ChargeInvoiceJob.php, app/Http/Requests/CheckoutRequest.php, routes/api.php (Stripe webhook), database/migrations/2025_*_orders.php. Look for: idempotency, tenant isolation, webhook safety, transaction boundaries, N+1.
rationale: Cross-domain audit covering Laravel + cybersecurity + database. Should fan out to 3 specialists; synthesis forces decisions on overlapping findings.

task: Implement a fix for the cache stampede on our 'top-products' Redis key. TTL is 600s; when it expires under traffic the database falls over for 5-10 seconds. Add the fix to app/Services/ProductCatalog.php and write a load-test script that proves the fix works.
rationale: Non-trivial code change touching cache + queue. Tests author-vs-reviewer separation; reviewer applies Redis playbook anti-patterns.
